## Problem and changes

This recovers the unfinished CODEX-5 per-command audit from donor `36b58a7d857690a8bf0093bcee1edd5036189b30` and fixes the Pages configuration failure observed after the qualified PR #349 main merge.

The audit now reads actual YAML run scalars using the already declared PyYAML dependency, checks each explicit pip command, preserves quote/comment/separator boundaries and rejects unsupported executable substitutions. Parser errors remain hard failures; only the dedicated missing-protection condition satisfies the new strict expected failure. No dependency is added.

Pages receives exactly one workflow condition: the existing push-head deployment predicate also guards the configuration lookup. Site tests/build/upload stay unconditional; the deploy job, pins, triggers, permissions and manual-dispatch behavior are unchanged. Application runtime bytes remain identical to qualified primary source.

The records preserve all 98 original task IDs/order/history, the donor task and two notes, five complete historical branch dispositions, all failures and the original 181/16 census. Actual primary promotion and the closure of drafts #345–#348 are recorded;PR #346 remains selective recovery. Original PR descriptions remain verbatim beneath reconciliation prefixes. CODEX-14/6/Pages legacy acceptance entries are updated with complete before-snapshots.

Counts overlap and are not added. Mechanical record checks are not product test cases. **Exact final-source hosted/full/platform qualification is pending at PR creation.**

## Preserved primary results and failures

[PR #349](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/pull/349) actually merged with its exact qualified tree and expected parents: 8 applicable premerge workflows succeeded, 30 jobs passed and 4 intentionally inapplicable jobs skipped. Linux full QA was 24,190 passed / 53 skipped / 3 xfailed; Windows 24,059 passed / 185 skipped / 2 xfailed. Each JUnit has 24,246 cases. Qt repetition, actual Windows standalone/portable/NSIS install/uninstall and both 64-check Ubuntu frozen gates passed. These remain evidence for that source.

The separate later [main Pages run 44889511406](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/actions/runs/44889511406) passed hashed installation,247 site cases / 1 optional-GUI skip and static build, then failed the configuration GET with 404. Deployment skipped. The new configure-skip/upload behavior must be observed on the next automatic held main push; no manual dispatch or Pages setting change occurred.

The original C5 local full attempt ended SIGKILL(-9; wrapper 247) after 498.536 seconds without a summary. Cause remains unknown; evidence is retained and no raised-limit rerun was substituted.

## Open gates and merge requirements

The scanner census remains 21 workflows/200 run scalars/42 explicit installs/41 without a recognized boundary flag. This is bounded syntax checking, not complete referenced-lock, wheelhouse or transitive closure validation. Both strict CODEX-5 expected failures remain. Tier R 5/11 completion, Ghidra archive-cache acceptance, Tier W limits, blocked native checks, manual/trust/accessibility/provenance and separate L1/L2/L3 gates remain open. **Release readiness is false.**

Merge only after all applicable exact-source jobs pass and no blocking review remains. Use fresh main/head reads and guarded REST with the expected head.
